svg.title: SHOT3R — Editable teaser with separate raster assets
svg.desc: Text, camera symbols, arrows, shapes and timeline containers are vectors. Photos, point cloud, blocks and the three human-motion groups are embedded raster images. This is not an all-vector or 3D scene.
